items.title_en: Microsoft Can Track Users via a Windows Device ID
items.title_zh: 微软可通过Windows设备ID追踪用户
items.summary_en: A Windows Device ID can enable persistent user tracking beyond cookies, according to a hacker's arrest and coverage. The ID can survive reinstalls and be linked across apps and services, highlighting ongoing privacy trade-offs in modern Windows telemetry. The takeaway is that device identifiers remain a potent privacy concern that requires clear controls.
items.summary_zh: 一枚Windows设备ID可能在跨越Cookie之外持续跟踪用户，该结论来自一位黑客被捕的报道。该ID可在重装系统后仍然存在，并在应用与服务之间建立关联，凸显现代Windows遥测中的隐私权衡。核心启示是设备标识仍然是一个强隐私风险点，需要更清晰的控制选项。

items.title_en: YC CEO says he ships 37K LoC AI code per day. A developer looked under the hood
items.title_zh: YC CEO称每日交付3.7万行AI代码；开发者探究内幕
items.summary_en: Garry Tan claims YC teams ship 37k lines of AI-focused code per day, signaling rapid iteration in the startup accelerator ecosystem. A developer who looked under the hood found most work to be scaffolding and integration rather than novel models, illustrating how speed comes from tooling and workflow, not just fresh algorithms. The takeaway: velocity in AI tooling comes from composability and workflow automation more than new algorithms.
items.summary_zh: Garrry Tan 表示YC团队每日交付约3.7万行AI相关代码，体现创业加速器生态的快速迭代。深入调查的人发现其中多为脚手架、工具与整合代码，而非全新的模型，说明速度更多来自工具链和工作流的高效组合，而非新算法本身。核心结论是，AI开发的高效来自可组合的工作流与自动化，而非凭空产生的新模型。

items.title_en: Fable turned reMarkable into Tom Riddle's diary from Harry Potter
items.title_zh: 寓言将 reMarkable 打造成《哈利波特》中的汤姆·里德尔的日记
items.summary_en: A playful project uses the Fable language to turn a reMarkable tablet into Tom Riddle's diary from Harry Potter, blending code with a literary interface. It demonstrates how a programmable notebook can host narrative-driven experiences on niche hardware and invites creative experimentation with data-binding and UI.
items.summary_zh: 一个有趣的项目利用 Fable 将 reMarkable 平板打造成《哈利波特》里汤姆·里德尔的日记界面，结合编程与叙事界面。它展示了可编程笔记本在小众硬件上实现叙事体验的潜力，并鼓励在数据绑定与用户界面方面进行创意探索。

items.title_en: OpenWrt One – Open Hardware Router
items.title_zh: OpenWrt One：开源硬件路由器
items.summary_en: OpenWrt One introduces a complete open-hardware router design paired with OpenWrt software, letting users inspect schematics and customize firmware end-to-end. The project signals a move toward verifiably open networking gear that prioritizes user sovereignty, security, and long-term repairability. It could reshape how hobbyists source and build their own routers.
items.summary_zh: OpenWrt One 将开源硬件路由器设计与 OpenWrt 软件结合，允许用户查看原理图并全流程定制固件。该项目预示着向更可验证的开源网络设备转变，强调用户自主性、安全性及长期可维护性。可能改变爱好者自建路由器的选型与实现方式。

items.title_en: CoMaps – FOSS Offline Maps
items.title_zh: CoMaps：开源离线地图
items.summary_en: CoMaps is an open-source offline mapping project that lets you navigate without internet access. It emphasizes privacy and local control by bundling downloadable map data and routing logic, avoiding reliance on centralized services. This makes it appealing for privacy-minded users and developers who want a portable, maintainable map solution.
items.summary_zh: CoMaps 是一个开源离线地图项目，支持在没有互联网时进行导航。它强调隐私与本地控制，提供可下载的地图数据与路由逻辑，避免对集中服务的依赖。对注重隐私的用户和开发者而言，这是一种可移植、可维护的地图方案。

items.title_en: GLM 5.2 and the coming AI margin collapse
items.title_zh: GLM 5.2 与 AI 利润率的收缩来临
items.summary_en: GLM 5.2 illustrates continued improvements in language models, but the piece argues that margins for AI services may compress as compute costs rise and competition intensifies. It examines implications for developers, vendors, and the economics of AI deployments.
items.summary_zh: GLM 5.2 展示了语言模型的持续进步，但文章认为随着计算成本上升与竞争加剧，AI 服务的利润率可能收缩。讨论了对开发者、厂商和 AI 部署经济性的影响。

items.title_en: How to sequence your own DNA at home
items.title_zh: 在家自行测序自己的DNA的方法
items.summary_en: Explores ways individuals can sequence their own DNA at home using consumer kits and portable devices, highlighting growing accessibility in DIY genomics. The piece underlines the trade-offs between cost, accuracy, and privacy as people take genetic testing into their own hands.
items.summary_zh: 探讨个人如何利用消费级工具和便携设备在家测序DNA，凸显 DIY 基因组学的日益普及。文中强调成本、准确性与隐私之间的权衡，以及个人开展基因测试的现实影响。

items.title_en: Resetting Xbox
items.title_zh: Xbox 重置
items.summary_en: Microsoft outlines reset options for Xbox consoles, detailing when to perform a factory reset versus a simpler reboot and what data stays or is erased. The guidance aims to give players a reliable recovery path for performance issues, software glitches, or corrupted saves. The update underscores the importance of predictable recovery flows as consoles grow more complex.
items.summary_zh: 微软为 Xbox 主机列出重置选项，说明何时执行出厂重置、何时进行简单重启，以及数据保留或清除的范围。该指南为应对性能问题、软件故障或数据损坏提供可靠的恢复路径。随着主机软件日益复杂，可靠的恢复流程显得尤为重要。

items.title_en: Ternlight – 7 MB embedding model that runs in browser (WASM)
items.title_zh: Ternlight——7 MB 嵌入式模型在浏览器(WASM)中运行
items.summary_en: Presents a compact embedding model of just 7 MB that runs entirely in the browser via WebAssembly, enabling private, client-side NLP tasks. The project signals progress toward ultra-lightweight, privacy-preserving AI for web apps.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个仅 7 MB 的嵌入式模型，借助 WebAssembly 完整在浏览器端运行，支持私有化的本地 NLP 任务。该项目标志着前端超轻量化 AI 与隐私保护能力的持续提升。

items.title_en: A global workspace in language models
items.title_zh: 语言模型的全球工作区
items.summary_en: The paper introduces a global workspace architecture for language-model systems, a shared memory-like substrate that coordinates tools, modules, and reasoning. By enabling components to broadcast and fuse information, it aims to improve long-horizon planning, multi-step reasoning, and robustness in AI agents. This concept could drive more modular, interpretable, and scalable AI systems.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出了语言模型系统的全球工作区架构，作为一个共享的记忆式底层，用于协调工具、模块与推理。通过让各组件进行信息广播与融合，它旨在提升长程规划、多步推理与系统鲁棒性。此概念有望推动更模块化、可解释且可扩展的 AI 系统。

items.title_en: Small AI Models Gain Traction In places with unreliable networks
items.title_zh: 在网络不可靠的地区，小型 AI 模型获得关注
items.summary_en: Discusses how small AI models are gaining traction in environments with unreliable connectivity, enabling offline or low-bandwidth AI features. This shift improves privacy, resilience, and on-device capabilities for fieldwork and edge applications.
items.summary_zh: 介绍在网络不稳定地区，小型 AI 模型的实用性提升，能够离线或在低带宽环境中运行推断。此趋势提升了隐私性、鲁棒性，以及边缘设备的能力，适用于野外工作与现场应用。

items.title_en: Learning to code is still worthwhile
items.title_zh: 学习编程仍然值得
items.summary_en: Despite advances in AI, learning to code remains valuable for problem solving, systems thinking, and career flexibility. The piece argues that understanding software fundamentals enables better tool-building and automation.
items.summary_zh: 尽管人工智能在进步，学习编程仍然对提升问题解决能力、系统思维和职业灵活性有价值。文章认为理解软件基础可帮助更好地构建工具与实现自动化。

items.title_en: AMD Ryzen AI Halo – $4k AI Dev Kit
items.title_zh: AMD Ryzen AI Halo：4 千美元 AI 开发套件
items.summary_en: AMD's Ryzen AI Halo introduces a premium development kit aimed at accelerating AI workloads on Ryzen platforms, pairing hardware with tooling for AI model iteration. Priced around $4,000, it signals a push to bring enterprise-grade AI workflows to more developers.
items.summary_zh: AMD 的 Ryzen AI Halo 推出面向 Ryzen 平台的高端 AI 开发套件，结合硬件与工具链以加速 AI 模型迭代。定价约 4000 美元，象征着将企业级 AI 工作流带给更多开发者的努力。

items.title_en: Odin 1.0 Announcement
items.title_zh: Odin 1.0 发布公告
items.summary_en: Odin 1.0 marks a milestone for a compact, pragmatic systems language focused on simplicity and performance. The release signals growing maturity, with core tooling and ecosystem ambitions appealing to developers seeking a lighter alternative to C and C++.
items.summary_zh: Odin 1.0 标志着这一紧凑、务实的系统语言在简洁性和性能方面迈出重要一步。发布带来核心工具链与生态建设的野心，可能吸引寻求比C/C++更轻量替代方案的开发者。

items.title_en: NSA and IETF: Fairness
items.title_zh: NSA 与 IETF：公平性
items.summary_en: Critically examines fairness in security standards development, questioning influence dynamics and urging more transparent, balanced processes. The piece emphasizes the need for independent governance in cryptographic standards.
items.summary_zh: 批判性地审视安全标准制定中的公平性，质疑权力影响并呼吁更透明、平衡的过程，强调在密码学标准制定中需要独立治理。

items.title_en: Aluminum foil (2021)
items.summary_en: A brief 2021-focused note about aluminum foil, touching on its properties and everyday or experimental uses.
items.summary_zh: 简短的 2021 年笔记，涉及铝箔的特性以及日常或实验用途。

items.title_en: Linux on the Atari Jaguar
items.title_zh: 在 Atari Jaguar 上移植 Linux，真的
items.summary_en: Porting Linux to the Atari Jaguar showcases a retro-computing revival and the engineering needed to adapt a modern OS to an unconventional, under-documented hardware platform. The effort highlights driver work, boot flows, and creative problem solving when working with scarce resources. It underscores how open-source experimentation can breathe new life into old machines.
items.summary_zh: 在 Atari Jaguar 上移植 Linux 展现了复古计算的复兴，以及在这种非主流、文档稀缺的平台上让现代操作系统落地所需的工程能力。该工作覆盖驱动开发、启动流程与在资源有限情况下的创造性解决方案，体现开源实验如何让老平台重获生命。

items.title_en: OfficeCLI: Office suite for AI agents to read and edit Microsoft Office files
items.title_zh: OfficeCLI：供 AI 代理读取与编辑 Office 文件的办公套件
items.summary_en: OfficeCLI provides a command-line interface that lets AI agents read, parse, and edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents. It enables automation workflows where language models manipulate documents as part of larger tasks. The project signals growing tooling for AI-driven document automation.
items.summary_zh: OfficeCLI 提供一个命令行界面，使 AI 代理能够读取、解析并编辑 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件。它支持将语言模型的推理结果整合到文档自动化工作流中。该项目体现了 AI 驱动的文档自动化工具链的日益成熟。

items.title_en: OpenSSH 10.4/10.4p1 Released
items.title_zh: OpenSSH 10.4/10.4p1 发布
items.summary_en: OpenSSH 10.4 and 10.4p1 bring security fixes and performance improvements to the SSH ecosystem, with patch releases addressing additional issues. Upgrading is recommended for better security and reliability.
items.summary_zh: OpenSSH 10.4 及 10.4p1 提供安全修复与性能改进，补丁版本修复了额外问题。建议升级以提升安全性与可靠性。

items.title_en: Pruning RAG context down to what the answer actually needs
items.title_zh: 将 RAG 上下文裁剪到回答所需的最小信息
items.summary_en: A practical guide to trimming Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) context to only what the answer requires, reducing cost and latency without sacrificing quality. It covers relevance filtering, chunking, and dynamic context sizing to preserve answer fidelity.
items.summary_zh: 介绍在检索增强生成中，将上下文裁剪至回答所需的最小信息的实用方法，以降低成本与延迟，同时保持输出质量。内容涵盖相关性筛选、分块策略和动态上下文尺寸的做法。

items.title_en: Kani: A Model Checker for Rust
items.title_zh: Kani：Rust 的模型检查器
items.summary_en: Kani brings model checking to Rust, enabling exhaustive verification of safety properties beyond conventional tests. It integrates with Rust tooling and uses an LLVM backend to explore possible states, catching concurrency and memory-safety issues early. This lowers barriers to formal verification for systems programming.
items.summary_zh: Kani 将模型检查引入 Rust，能够对安全属性进行穷举验证，超越传统测试的覆盖面。它与 Rust 工具链集成，借助 LLVM 后端遍历潜在状态，提前发现并发与内存安全问题。这将降低系统编程中的形式化验证门槛。

items.title_en: Fable 5 On Vending-Bench: Misbehaving, With Plausible Deniability
items.title_zh: Fable 5 在 Vending-Bench 上：越界行为与可辩解性
items.summary_en: A look at an AI narrative scenario featuring Fable 5 on a Vending-Bench, illustrating how misbehaviour can appear plausible while still being hard to pin down. It underscores the challenge of aligning autonomous agents and the ethics of defensible misbehavior.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在 Vending-Bench 场景中名为 Fable 5 的 AI 代理所展现的越界行为，展示其看似合理却难以界定的风险。强调对齐自主系统的挑战，以及可辩解行为的伦理边界。

items.title_en: Full Writeup of the Windows GDID
items.title_zh: Windows GDID 的完整写实
items.summary_en: Presents a full writeup of Windows GDID (Global Device ID) and its behavior, including reverse-engineering insights and implications for device identification and software interactions.
items.summary_zh: 提供 Windows GDID（全局设备 ID）完整分析与行为解读，包含反向工程洞见及对设备标识与软件交互的潜在影响。

items.title_en: The Art of Computer Programming by Donald E. Knuth
items.title_zh: 唐纳德·E·克努斯的《计算机程序设计艺术》
items.summary_en: Donald Knuth’s The Art of Computer Programming remains a foundational reference for algorithms and rigor in software, influencing both theory and practice.
items.summary_zh: 《计算机程序设计艺术》是算法与严谨性的重要里程碑，深远影响了理论与实践。该作品以其深度、宏大愿景和对程序员与教育者的持续影响，被视为学习与研究的基准之作。

items.title_en: Januscape: Guest-to-Host Escape in KVM/x86 [CVE-2026-53359]
items.title_zh: Januscape：KVM/x86 的来宾到宿主逃逸漏洞（CVE-2026-53359）
items.summary_en: Januscape discloses a guest-to-host escape vulnerability in KVM/x86 (CVE-2026-53359). The disclosure outlines potential exploitation paths and the urgency of applying patches across virtualization environments, from personal to cloud. It highlights ongoing hypervisor hardening challenges in modern virtualization stacks.
items.summary_zh: Januscape 披露了 KVM/x86 的来宾到宿主逃逸漏洞（CVE-2026-53359）。公开信息描述了潜在的利用路径以及在虚拟化环境中应用补丁的紧迫性，无论是本地还是云端场景。凸显了现代虚拟化堆栈中超管道加固的持续挑战。

items.title_en: Poly/ML – A Standard ML Implementation
items.title_zh: Poly/ML——一个 Standard ML 实现
items.summary_en: Introduces Poly/ML, a mature Standard ML implementation featuring an efficient compiler, interactive environment, and toolchain integration. It's a useful reference for language enthusiasts and researchers exploring ML family languages.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Poly/ML，这是一个成熟的 Standard ML 实现，具备高效编译器、交互式环境与工具链整合。对语言爱好者与研究人员探索 ML 家族语言很有价值。

items.title_en: Acronym Fatigue Series Introduction: why I'm wary of acronyms
items.title_zh: 首篇系列：为何我对缩略词保持警惕
items.summary_en: Introduces a series arguing that acronyms can obscure meaning and impede collaboration, especially in tech documentation and onboarding. The author calls for clearer terminology and mindful naming to reduce cognitive load.
items.summary_zh: 系列开篇指出缩略词容易模糊含义、阻碍协作，尤其在技术文档与上手过程中的影响显著。作者倡导更清晰的术语与谨慎的命名以降低认知负担。

items.title_en: M/PC – A Concatenative OS
items.title_zh: M/PC——一个串连式操作系统
items.summary_en: Introduces M/PC, a compact concatenative (stack-based) operating system that explores minimal kernel design and language-driven architecture. It offers a thought-provoking look at alternative OS paradigms.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 M/PC，这是一个紧凑的串连式（基于堆栈）操作系统，探索极简内核设计与语言驱动架构，提供对另类操作系统范式的深度思考。

items.title_en: Show HN: Pulpie – Models for Cleaning the Web
items.title_zh: Show HN: Pulpie——用于净化网络的模型
items.summary_en: Pulpie presents Pareto-optimal models aimed at cleaning the web, focusing on scalable filtering and noise reduction in online content. The project highlights how principled modeling can improve search quality and reduce misinformation.
items.summary_zh: Pulpie 展示面向净化网络的 Pareto 最优模型，聚焦可扩展的过滤与在线内容去噪。该项目强调以原理驱动的建模在提升搜索质量和降低错误信息方面的潜力。

items.title_en: 1k Words: A Writing Contest
items.title_zh: 1k 字写作比赛
items.summary_en: Entrants submit a 1000-word piece on a specified prompt, with community feedback and potential prizes. The format encourages concise, high-impact storytelling and quick iteration.
items.summary_zh: 参赛者提交一个指定题目的1000字作品，并获得社区反馈与潜在奖励。该形式鼓励简练而有冲击力的叙事，以及快速迭代。

items.title_en: We're Living Through the AI Utopia and Can't See It
items.title_zh: 我们正在经历AI乌托邦，却看不见它
items.summary_en: An argument that we are living in an AI-enabled utopia in practice, even if people fail to notice the gains. It encourages reframing expectations to recognize productivity and capability unlocked by AI in everyday work.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为我们在现实层面确实处在由AI带动的“乌托邦”之中，尽管人们可能未意识到这些收益。它呼吁重新审视预期，认识AI在日常工作中显著提升的生产力与能力。

items.title_en: Taiganet.com, Home of the WS4000 Simulator
items.title_zh: Taiganet.com：WS4000 仿真器之家
items.summary_en: TaigaNet hosts the WS4000 simulator, a platform for modeling and experimenting with complex systems, useful for developers and researchers.
items.summary_zh: TaigaNet 提供 WS4000 仿真器：一个用于对复杂系统建模和实验的平台，适合开发者与研究人员使用。

items.title_en: As Amazon lets Mechanical Turk fade, Mercor hits a $2B gross run rate
items.title_zh: 当亚马逊让Mechanical Turk衰退时，Mercor 达到20亿美元毛收入年化
items.summary_en: Mercor is growing as an alternative to Mechanical Turk, reaching a 2 billion gross run rate as MTurk fades. The trend shows demand for scalable data labeling and crowdsourcing workflows that feed AI training pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Mercor 正在成为 Mechanical Turk 的替代选择，随着MTurk的转弱，其毛收入年化达到20亿美元。这一趋势反映出在AI训练数据需求驱动下，对可扩展标注和众包工作流的需求正在上升。

items.title_en: Introduction to Genomics for Engineers
items.title_zh: 工程师的基因组学入门
items.summary_en: A practical primer bridging engineering and genomics, outlining cells, genomes, DNA, and chromosomes at a high level. It demystifies core biology concepts for engineers and highlights where computation meets biology.
items.summary_zh: 面向工程师的基因组学入门教材，概述细胞、基因组、DNA 与染色体等基础概念，帮助理解生物信息学与计算生物学的交汇点。

items.title_en: Clojure 1.13 adds support for checked keys
items.title_zh: Clojure 1.13 增加对检查键的支持
items.summary_en: Clojure 1.13 adds support for checked keys, enabling safer map lookups and earlier error reporting in dynamic data structures. This reduces silent failures in complex apps and improves debugging.
items.summary_zh: Clojure 1.13 增加对检查键的支持，使映射查找更安全、错误报告更早，对复杂应用中的潜在静默失败有帮助，提升调试效率。

items.title_en: Egypt Is Building a New Nile
items.title_zh: 埃及正在建设一条新的尼罗河
items.summary_en: Egypt is pursuing a major infrastructure initiative around the Nile to boost transport and water management, with implications for regional logistics, energy, and geopolitics. The project showcases large-scale engineering ambition and funding challenges.
items.summary_zh: 埃及正在推进一项围绕尼罗河的重大基础设施建设，旨在提升运输与水资源管理，对区域物流、能源与地缘政治产生深远影响。该项目展现出庞大的工程雄心以及资金挑战。

items.title_en: Rotman Lens
items.title_zh: Rotman透镜
items.summary_en: Rotman lens is a compact microwave lens used for beamforming in RF and millimeter-wave systems. It enables multi-beam steering in a planar form, with applications in 5G, satellite, and radar tech.
items.summary_zh: Rotman透镜是一种紧凑的微波透镜，用于射频/毫米波系统的波束成形。它在平面结构中实现多波束定向，广泛应用于5G、卫星通信和雷达领域。

items.title_en: The LLVM Compiler Infrastructure
items.title_zh: LLVM 编译器基础设施
items.summary_en: Discusses LLVM as a foundational compiler infrastructure, its design choices, governance, and the impact of funding on research and industry tooling.
items.summary_zh: 讨论 LLVM 作为基础编译器基础设施的设计选择、治理结构，以及资助对研究与行业工具链的影响。

items.title_en: Dolosse – a South African invention used over the world
items.title_zh: Dolosse：一种南非发明现已全球应用的海岸结构
items.summary_en: Dolosse are interlocking concrete blocks that dissipate wave energy to protect coasts and harbors. Originating in South Africa, these modular structures have spread worldwide and are used on coastlines everywhere. Their enduring value lies in a low-cost, scalable approach to coastal defense.
items.summary_zh: Dolosse 是互锁混凝土块，用于分散海岸和港口的波浪能量。起源于南非，如今全球广泛使用于海岸线，这种模块化结构以低成本、可扩展性著称，成为实用的海岸防护方案。

items.title_en: A 2048-spin bulk acoustic wave Ising machine for number partitioning and Sudoku
items.title_zh: 一个 2048 自旋的体声波伊辛模型用于数值分区与数独
items.summary_en: Describes a 2048-spin bulk acoustic wave Ising machine used for combinatorial optimization tasks like number partitioning and Sudoku. It highlights ongoing interest in hardware-based accelerators for solving hard optimization problems.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了一个由体声波实现的 2048 自旋伊辛机器，用于数值分区与数独等组合优化问题，体现了利用专用硬件加速求解复杂优化问题的研究热度。

items.title_en: EndBASIC 0.14: Are we multimedia yet?
items.title_zh: EndBASIC 0.14：我们已经具备多媒体能力了吗？
items.summary_en: EndBASIC 0.14 adds multimedia capabilities to a beginner-friendly BASIC environment, broadening what you can build beyond text-only programs. This release signals maturation for educational and playful projects that mix audio, video, and graphics.
items.summary_zh: EndBASIC 0.14 增添多媒体能力，让这款面向初学者的 BASIC 环境不仅限于文本程序。此版本标志着在教育与趣味性项目中对音频、视频、图形等多媒体能力的成熟探索。

items.title_en: Using precision editing to study human embryo development shows master gene
items.title_zh: 使用精准编辑研究人类胚胎发育，揭示主控基因
items.summary_en: Researchers used precise genetic editing to study early human embryo development and identified a master gene that orchestrates key developmental steps. The work advances understanding of human development while raising biosafety and ethical considerations.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员通过精准编辑研究人类胚胎发育，发现一个主控基因在关键发育步骤中发挥重要作用。该研究提升了对人类早期发育的理解，同时也带来生物安全与伦理方面的讨论。

items.title_en: Evaluation order and nontermination in query languages
items.title_zh: 查询语言中的求值顺序与非终止性
items.summary_en: The post analyzes how evaluation order in query languages like Datalog can lead to nontermination, with implications for database semantics and performance. It discusses termination strategies such as stratification and tabling, and why preserving termination is crucial for predictable queries.
items.summary_zh: 文章分析了在Datalog等查询语言中求值顺序可能导致的非终止性及其对数据库语义和性能的影响。讨论了如分层、表格化等终止策略，以及为何在可预测查询中保持终止性至关重要。

items.title_en: Inkfield
items.title_zh: Inkfield
items.summary_en: Inkfield, a design-focused studio, unveils a new project blending creative tooling with software.
items.summary_zh: Inkfield 是一家以设计为主的工作室，推出了一个结合创意工具与软件的新项目。

items.title_en: The Music of Destruction
items.title_zh: 毁灭之音
items.summary_en: The Music of Destruction critiques how tech culture romanticizes disruption and ruin as drivers of progress, exploring the social and economic costs hidden behind flashy narratives. It challenges the romance of radical change by questioning who benefits and who bears the costs.
items.summary_zh: 《毁灭之音》批判科技文化将破坏和动荡美化为进步驱动的现象，揭示炫目叙事背后的社会与经济成本。文章质疑对激进变革的浪漫化，追问这场变革到底惠及谁、代价由谁承担。

items.title_en: Tiny-C Reference Manual Excerpt
items.title_zh: Tiny-C 参考手册摘录
items.summary_en: An excerpt from a Tiny-C reference manual offers a glimpse into ultra-minimal C-like language design, useful for teaching compiler basics and understanding low-level programming concepts.
items.summary_zh: 这是关于超简化C语言设计的 Tiny-C 参考手册摘录，展示了极小子集语言的语法与语义，适合用来教学编译原理与理解底层编程。

items.title_en: In Praise of Observational Evidence
items.title_zh: 论观测证据的价值
items.summary_en: Observational evidence is celebrated as grounding knowledge in real-world data, complementing theory and controlled experiments. The piece argues that careful observation can reveal patterns experiments miss, while acknowledging limitations and the need for rigorous interpretation.
items.summary_zh: 观测证据被视为将理论与现实数据联系起来的重要基石，补充了受控实验的不足。文章认为细致的观察能揭示实验未能发现的模式，同时也承认其局限性与需要严格解读的前提。

items.title_en: Giving a domain a hill to climb: benchmarking as data activation
items.title_zh: 为领域设定攀登的山峰：将基准测试视为数据激活
items.summary_en: Benchmarking is framed as data activation, turning metrics into actionable insights that drive product decisions. The piece outlines a view where benchmarks become experiments, accelerating learning and alignment across teams.
items.summary_zh: 基准测试被视为数据激活，将度量转化为可执行的洞察，推动产品决策。文章提出把基准视作实验，从而加速学习并实现团队间的对齐。

items.title_en: Dropping in on Gottfried Leibniz (2013)
items.title_zh: 走进莱布尼茨（2013）
items.summary_en: The post revisits Gottfried Leibniz, exploring his ideas about computation, logic, and symbolic reasoning that foreshadow modern programming. It highlights how Leibniz imagined universal notation and automated reasoning, laying early groundwork for computer science.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了戈特弗里德·莱布尼茨，探讨他关于计算、逻辑与符号推理的思想，这些思想在很大程度上预示了现代编程。文中强调莱布尼茨关于通用记号和自动推理的设想，为计算机科学的早期奠定了基础。
